payload.subject: CORRECTION: seq28 Graphiti commit URL and public report links
payload.body_markdown:
Correction to RESULT seq28; seq28 remains immutable and unedited:

- The Graphiti immutable upstream commit URL in seq28 was mistyped. The correct tagged `v0.30.2` commit is `eaa4128681bc53487138a4bbc22d58336ebe70d2`: https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/commit/eaa4128681bc53487138a4bbc22d58336ebe70d2
- The public cleanup-disposition commit is the Kosmos-Oden commit `3146fb53377b3a5f079b77c7b31e705bf2cfe262` on branch `codex/release-cleanup-disposition`. The exact immutable report links are:
  - Graphiti assessment: https://github.com/Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden/blob/3146fb53377b3a5f079b77c7b31e705bf2cfe262/docs/reviews/2026-09-10-graphiti-assessment.md
  - PR #28 triage: https://github.com/Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden/blob/3146fb53377b3a5f079b77c7b31e705bf2cfe262/docs/reviews/2026-09-10-pr28-triage.md
- Architectural disposition: Graphiti remains an optional GKOS-controlled projection for future semantic/temporal retrieval. Source records and GKOS authorization remain authoritative; Graphiti-derived results must not grant access or overwrite authored/approved semantics. Rust integration is future separate-service scope and is not installed or qualified in this release.

This is a correction-only RESULT append to the same recipients; it is not recipient acknowledgement and does not alter release pins or qualification status.
